title: Norm bound for a restricted matrix
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $A$ be a real $n\times n$ symmetric matrix with nonnegative entries and row sums equal to $1$. Define $\lambda(A)$ as the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors orthogonal to the constant vector whose entries are $1/n$. Suppose $\lambda(A)\le\lambda$, $0\le\lambda\le1$, and $\beta\ge0$. For a subset $B\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|B|\le\beta n$, let $A_B$ be obtained by replacing the rows of $A$ outside $B$ by zero. Then every vector $x\in\mathbb R^n$ satisfies $\|A_Bx\|\le\big((1-\lambda)\sqrt{\beta}+\lambda\big)\|x\|$.
